text: We were thrilled to have Heather Wolfe Art (Live Painting) as part of our wedding day. From the moment we first reached out, their communication was personable, quick, and amazing. The quality of their work was truly exceptional, with insane attention to detail and a remarkable final product. Our guests were constantly complimenting the live painting, and Heather's positive energy added so much to our special day. This is something we will keep forever to remember our wedding, and we cannot recommend Heather Wolfe Art enough to any couple looking for a unique and unforgettable addition to their big day.
